g.text: Select a task graph using its “Use when” instruction.
The question requires retrieving facts about a single entity without chaining multiple

rect.title: - Extract the main question or task from the input. - Identify key entities (e.g., people, places, events) and required relations (e.g., "born in", "played for"). - Determine the number of hops needed to answer the question.
- Search for factual information about each identified entity. - Use context passages to locate relevant sentences containing the entity. - Record supporting facts for later reasoning.

- Cross-check the inferred final answer against all supporting facts. - Ensure no contradictions exist in the evidence chain. - Format the answer as required (e.g., `<answer>...</answer>`).
---

g.text: The question involves multiple sequential relations (e.g., "Who was born in the same
city as the director of X?").

rect.title: - Extract the main question or task from the input. - Identify key entities (e.g., people, places, events) and required relations (e.g., "born in", "played for"). - Determine the number of hops needed to answer the question.
- Search for factual information about each identified entity. - Use context passages to locate relevant sentences containing the entity. - Record supporting facts for later reasoning.

- Based on retrieved facts, determine intermediate entities connecting the start and end of the query chain. - Verify that each inferred entity has supporting evidence in the context. - Update the reasoning path if contradictions arise.

- Cross-check the inferred final answer against all supporting facts. - Ensure no contradictions exist in the evidence chain. - Format the answer as required (e.g., `<answer>...</answer>`).
